summary: Maps an enum a2 (0, 1, 2) to a state value (1, 3, 2) and dispatches it to the global object at 0x008B89A0 through its vtable entry at offset 252. Skips when a2 is -1 or equals the stored previous value this[15], otherwise records a2 into this[15] after dispatch.

operations.description: Skip when a2 is -1 or when a2 already equals the stored previous value this[15] (offset 0x3C).
When a2 is 0, dispatch on the global object at 0x008B89A0 through vtable+252 with (*this, 14, 1).
When a2 is 1, dispatch on the global object at 0x008B89A0 through vtable+252 with (*this, 14, 3).
When a2 is 2, dispatch on the global object at 0x008B89A0 through vtable+252 with (*this, 14, 2).
Record the new value a2 into this[15] (offset 0x3C) after a successful dispatch.

unresolved: The meaning of state parameter 14 and of the 1/3/2 value mapping is owned by the vtable+252 handler on the global object, not by this function.
this[15] (offset 0x3C) is compared and updated here but consumed elsewhere.
